headline: Dataset is clean: all exact checks (structure, image integrity, box geometry, normalisation, class IDs, train/val leakage) passed with zero findings — safe to train on today.
training_impact: Training will run and the validation number will be trustworthy: no corrupt images, no malformed or out-of-bounds/degenerate boxes, no denormalised coordinates, no class-ID errors, and no train/val leakage. The only caveat is class skew (person ~1983 train instances vs truck 201 / bench 185 / backpack 196), which will bias mAP toward frequent classes; consider per-class weighting or augmentation for the rare classes if they matter to your metric.
